title: podman-wslkerninst: remove unused binary
body:
The Windows installer no longer references this binary: the WiX bundle entry that launched it was removed in 91e4f69 ("Remove the option to install WSL/HyperV") and the build step in df4aed7 ("Remove providers checks from the Windows Installer"). Nothing else in the tree references it, so the code is dead and this PR drops it entirely.

This supersedes the earlier path.Base to filepath.Base fix that was previously on this branch: with the binary gone there is no log prefix to repair.

Related to: #25165
